response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT archstat, project_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT archstat, project_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing status means a NULL archstat. NULLs form one group, shown as a NULL status, and empty strings are not treated as missing.
The share denominator is the sum of the per-status distinct-project counts. A project with several statuses is counted in each, so the denominator can exceed the number of distinct projects.
The average share is the mean of the per-status shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of status groups, NULL group included. Results are not rounded.
